ratchet: L1 quarantine (issue #930). Rows only SHRINK. A row is legal only while it names a filed GitHub issue for a CONFIRMED reducer defect — a row without an issue number fails the suite (SKIP is never PASS) — and only while the defect still reproduces: once it is fixed the row must be DELETED, which the hygiene test enforces. A row skips exactly one (law, command) pair; `seed: null` with `stream_id: "*"` means the defect is not seed-specific and every stream that hits it is covered by the one issue.
